excerpt.zh:
我们天空中的异光消散了，提前宣告了我们的特工之后汇报的事情：他们激活了能量信标，将万华镜寄生虫引走了！

现在就让[target.GetName]去处理这麻烦吧。
excerpt.en:
The lights have faded from our skies, first announcing what our intelligence operatives later confirmed: our operators activated the energy beacon, luring the Kaleidoscope away!

Let the [target.GetName] deal with it now.

texts.zh:
我们天空中的异光消散了，提前宣告了我们的特工之后汇报的事情：他们激活了能量信标，将万华镜寄生虫引走了！

现在就让[target.GetName]去处理这麻烦吧。
texts.en:
The lights have faded from our skies, first announcing what our intelligence operatives later confirmed: our operators activated the energy beacon, luring the Kaleidoscope away!

Let the [target.GetName] deal with it now.

texts.zh:
我们的人民从轨道上看到的是[capital_scope.GetName]突然关停，城市内的每个光源都被熄灭。而[capital_scope.GetName]的居民所经历的更糟糕：车辆变成了路障，工厂停止运转，医院设备处于无响应的状态。这是一次全球性的突然停电，突如其来，莫名其妙。

当寂静和阴影笼罩着我们的星球时，奇怪的光芒在天空中绽放，将我们的首都恒星系包围在万华镜般的迷雾中。这两个事件无疑是相关的，但我们的[root.GetTechnicianPlural]仍然在抓瞎——是的，字面意义上的抓瞎。
texts.en:
What our people saw from orbit was [capital_scope.GetName] shutting down, every light source within the city snuffed out at once. What people on [capital_scope.GetName] experienced was much worse: vehicles reduced to road blocks, factories grinding to a halt, hospital equipment lifeless and inert. A world-wide blackout, as sudden as it was inexplicable.

As silence and shadows veiled our world, strange light patterns bloomed in the sky, enveloping our capital system in a kaleidoscopic mist. The two events are doubtlessly related, but our [root.GetTechnicianPlural] are still - literally - in the dark.

texts.zh: 我们的传感器报告万华镜寄生虫发光图样的幻影出现在了[kaleidoscope_system.GetName]恒星系。这个现象的自然机理暂时还不清楚。
texts.en: Our sensors report the apparition of kaleidoscopic light patterns in the [kaleidoscope_system.GetName] system. The nature of the phenomenon is unclear.

texts.zh: 我们先前观察到的万华镜幻影已经移动到了[kaleidoscope_system.GetName]恒星系。
texts.en: The kaleidoscopic apparition we previously observed has moved to the [kaleidoscope_system.GetName] system.

texts.zh:
我们在自己的电网系统中找不到任何缺陷。我们的发电机正在产生能量，但是某种存在……某种存在正在吸收它。这可能是我们在天空中能够观察到光图案的结果，这个图案的几何性质透露出一定的智慧痕迹。

这个东西——这个活着的万华镜——是一个满怀恶意的存在，还是一团无意识的迷雾？答案尚未明确。
texts.en:
We can find no defects in our power grid. Our generators are producing energy, but something is... absorbing it. It may be a result of the light patterns witnessed in our skies, the geometric nature of which betray an intelligent design.

Is this thing - this living Kaleidoscope - a malicious entity, or just a mindless mist? The answer is unclear.

label.zh: 试图将它从我们的电网中剥离出来。
label.en: Attempt to detach it from our power grid.

texts.zh:
多亏了我们的[owner.GetTechnicianPlural]和[owner.GetScientistPlural]的通力合作，我们设法将能量寄生虫从我们的电力网络中剔除了。我们最漫长的黑夜已经过去，但是万华镜寄生虫仍然在我们的头顶上闪耀，渴望能量。

我们无法与它进行交流，常规武器对这类生物无效。我们剩下的选项是给它提供足够的能量以维持其心情满足，或者试图让它挨饿。我们的特工还建议组织一次谍报行动，将它引诱到另一个帝国。让其他人来处理它。
texts.en:
Thanks to the coordinated effort of our [owner.GetTechnicianPlural] and [owner.GetScientistPlural], the energy parasite has been cut from our power grid. Our longest night is over, but the Kaleidoscope still shines upon us, hungry for energy.

We have no way to communicate with it, and conventional weaponry won't work on a being of this kind. Our remaining options are to feed it just enough to keep it appeased, or try to starve it. Our operatives also suggested organizing an Espionage Operation to lure it towards another empire. Let someone else deal with it.

texts.zh:
我们的人民从轨道上看到的是一个熟悉的图案再次出现：[capital_scope.GetName]上的所有电源突然关闭，我们的首都受到全球停电的打击，而熹微的光亮在天空中跃动。
万华镜回来了！我们曾经将这个能量寄生虫诱骗到其他国家，现在又给送了回来。

根据我们专家的分析，投资建设一个行星护盾生成器能够防止我们的首都再次成为目标，但是一切都为时已晚：因为能量寄生虫已经待这儿不走了。
texts.en:
What our people saw from orbit was the repetition of a familiar pattern: all power on [capital_scope.GetName] shutting down, our capital hit by a worldwide blackout while shimmering lights danced in the sky.
The Kaleidoscope has returned! The energy parasite we once foisted onto others has been sent back to us.

According to our experts, investing in a Planetary Shield Generator will prevent our capital from being targeted again, but it's too late for now: the energy parasite is here to stay.

label.zh: 这个非自然的野兽别想在我们的恒星系容身！
label.en: The unnatural monster has no space in our system!

label.zh: 我们必须和这个奇迹之兽交好！
label.en: We must befriend this wondrous creature!
It wants energy? Let it choke on it.

texts.zh:
在在最后一阵红色的起伏图案爆发之后，万华镜消失了，它的彩色卷须像雾一样消散了。

在它的光芒下度过了这么长时间后，我们的天空看起来空落落的。
texts.en:
After a final burst of red, undulating patterns, the Kaleidoscope faded away, its colorful tendrils dissipating like mist.

After so much time spent beneath its lights, our skies look almost empty.

texts.zh: 传感器回报我们在[kaleidoscope_system.GetName]恒星系探测到的万华镜图案已经消退了。
texts.en: Sensors report the kaleidoscopic pattern we detected in the [kaleidoscope_system.GetName] system has faded away.

texts.zh:
我们有幸得出体验星系最壮观的灯光秀：万华镜的花瓣往复折叠、盛开、绽放！然而，我们的仪器则带来了一则不那么令人高兴的消息。

这种能量生物变得如此充满力量，它甚至像一颗垂死的恒星一样发生了坍缩。在它的废墟中，我们的探测器发现了一个外形非常类似花朵的晶体团簇。根据初步研究，这种“花”可以放大最微弱的光线，在这个过程中打破了一些已知的物理定律。我们的[root.owner.GetScientistPlural]推测，这种花不过是一座光线可以被无限地反射叠加的多维镜屋中可见的冰山一角。
texts.en:
We have been blessed to experience the galaxy's most splendid light show: kaleidoscopic petals folding into themselves; blooming; exploding! However, our instruments tell a less triumphant story.

The energy being became so full of power it collapsed into itself like a dying star. From the devastation, our probes retrieved a crystalline cluster, shaped very much like a flower blossom. According to preliminary studies, the 'flower' can magnify the intensity of the faintest light ray, breaking a few known laws of physics in the process. Our [root.owner.GetScientistPlural] hypothesize the flower is merely the visible part of a larger construct - a multi-dimensional house of mirrors where light beams are infinitely reflected and recombined.

texts.zh: 传感器报告[kaleidoscope_system.GetName]恒星系中万华镜的图案发生了剧烈的绽放，并在五彩斑斓的爆炸中消失了。那场面一定相当壮观。
texts.en: Sensors report the kaleidoscopic pattern in the [kaleidoscope_system.GetName] system just bloomed, disappearing in a final burst of colorful patterns. Must have been quite the spectacle.

texts.zh:
万华镜自我折叠的一瞬，它看起来就像一朵最精致的水晶花。然而，随之而来的爆炸一点也不温和：一股灼热的爆炸席卷了整个星系，我们所有的电子设备都发生了过载，烧焦了能源电网。

维修工作已经在进行中，但我们还需要一段时间才能适应这片空旷的天空。
texts.en:
When the Kaleidoscope folded into itself, just for a second, it looked like the most delicate crystalline flower. However, the ensuing explosion was anything but gentle: a coruscating boom that scorched the system and overloaded all our electronic devices, frying our energy grid.

Repairs are already underway, but it will take some time for us to get used to the newly empty sky.

texts.zh: 传感器报告在[kaleidoscope_system.GetName]恒星系的万华镜图案爆炸了，释放了一道能量冲击波损坏了星系中所有的设施。
texts.en: Sensors report the kaleidoscopic pattern in the [kaleidoscope_system.GetName] system just exploded, releasing an energy shockwave that doubtlessly damaged every structure in the system.

texts.zh:
万华镜寄生虫盘附在了我们提供的改版戴森球上，吞食着一整个恒星的能量，其不断延展的、色彩缤纷的花瓣包覆了整个恒星系。根据我们的数据，这个噬能生命体现在处于一种恒定的、可控的超载状态，在一个类似于死亡和重生的无尽循环中，不断地长出新芽，再不断地爆裂。

我们不知道这个生命体是否有思考能力，但我们希望它的存在本身现在和它产生的光图案一样令人愉快。
texts.en:
The Kaleidoscope has latched onto the modified Dyson Sphere we provided, consuming the energy of a star and extending its colorful petals to encompass the whole system. According to our data, the energy being is now in a state of constant, controlled overload, perpetually growing new buds and bursting in an endless cycle akin to death and rebirth.

We do not know if the being is capable of thought, but we hope its existence is now as pleasant as the patterns of light it produces.

texts.zh:
一种五彩斑斓的能源寄生虫正在侵染我们的能源电网，提高了我们的能源供给。我们可以放任它，或者通过谍报行动将这个麻烦传导到其他帝国。

[GetKaleidoscopeMood]。
texts.en:
A colorful energy parasite is infecting our power grid, feasting on our energy supplies. We could indulge it, or use an Espionage Operation to pass this problem to another empire.

[GetKaleidoscopeMood].

sections.zh: 让万华镜寄生虫挨饿会降低它的心情，提高负面事件的发生几率。给它投喂会提高它的心情，维持它愉悦和稳定。
sections.en: Starving the Kaleidoscope will lower its mood, increasing the chance of negative events. Feeding it will increase it, keeping it appeased and placid.

sections.zh: 让万华镜寄生虫挨饿会降低它的心情，提高负面事件的发生几率。给它投喂会提高它的心情，维持它愉悦和稳定。
sections.en: Starving the Kaleidoscope will lower its mood, increasing the chance of negative events. Feeding it will increase it, keeping it appeased and placid.

texts.zh: 能源电网的全球性故障使我们的首都陷入了完全的黑暗。我们必须恢复[root.GetName]的电力基础设施，并压实相应责任主体。
texts.en: A global failure of the energy grid has plunged our capital into total darkness. We must restore [root.GetName]'s power infrastructure and determine what is taking place.
